title: Z9.F infinite sum — Genuine HasSum to the exact odd-zeta linear form
milestone_description: Let $n$ be even and $W\in\mathbb Q[X]$ satisfy $2n+2\operatorname{natdeg}W\le9(n+1)-2$. Then the actual positive rational sequence has genuine HasSum to $B_n(W)+\rho_{n,3}(W)\Re\zeta(3)+\rho_{n,5}(W)\Re\zeta(5)+\rho_{n,7}(W)\Re\zeta(7)+\rho_{n,9}(W)\Re\zeta(9)$. Both summability and actual rho cancellations are proved, without additional rho/summability/zeta inputs. The specialization $n=0,W=X^3$ gives the actual zeta3 series. In contrast, $n=0,W=X^4$ is outside the strong domain: its totalized Lean tsum is0 but it has no HasSum to any real number.
